name: bb-plugin-sandbox
description: bb plugin (proof of concept): run commands in isolated, resource-capped sandboxes behind one provider contract and an admission queue.

bb.name: Sandbox
bb.description: Run a command in an isolated sandbox (`bb sandbox run`), admitted by a queue that keeps the machine under a CPU and memory budget. Proof of concept with a local bubblewrap provider.

scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && bb plugin build
